# ona_group (Resource)

Manages a custom group in the organization the API key authenticates to. System-managed groups cannot be managed with this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ona_group" "platform" {
  name        = "platform"
  description = "Platform engineering team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name. The API accepts 3 to 80 characters.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Group description. The API accepts at most 255 characters.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the group was created (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Group ID.
- `member_count` (Number) Number of members in the group.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID the group belongs to. Resolved from the authenticated identity.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the group was last updated (RFC3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ona_group.platform <group-id>
```
